title: Restricted reduction preserves triangulated properties
statement: Use the actual integral coefficients of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. For any scheme X, any isomorphism-invariant triangulated object property P of integral derived modules, any K satisfying P, and any supplied left-derived tensor description of restricted integralReduction, the restricted reduction of K satisfies P.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.9(3), Proposition 6.8.11(3), Remark 6.8.15; explicit formal coefficient and adjunction argument

proof.text: Pull the short exact integral coefficient sequence to X by exact monoidal inverse image and identify it with multiplication by ℓ on the regular integral module followed by the restricted residue regular module.

Choose a K-flat representative of K. The left-derived tensor counit is invertible there. Tensor symmetry, termwise tensor comparison, and the two-term free coefficient resolution identify restricted reduction with the cone of multiplication by ℓ.
The mapping-cone triangle is distinguished and its first two objects are isomorphic to K. Triangulated closure and isomorphism invariance imply the claim.
